# QRix

> QRix (qrixtools.com) is a free all-in-one browser toolbox: 185+ tools for
> QR codes, PDF, images, AI and video — no signup, no watermarks, no file
> limits. Most tools process files on-device for privacy. Free forever;
> optional Pro adds team features.

Key facts: QR codes made with QRix never expire. PDF→Word keeps layout 1:1
(tables, fonts). The social downloader supports 16 platforms (TikTok
no-watermark, Instagram, VK, OK.ru, X and more; no YouTube). Interfaces in
English, Russian and Uzbek. A Telegram bot (@qrix_downloader_bot) returns
videos in chat; the @QRixtools channel posts a free tool daily.

## Core tools
- [QR Code Generator](https://qrixtools.com/): 30+ QR types, logos, colors, AI QR art, bulk CSV, scan analytics, never expires
- [Video Downloader](https://qrixtools.com/downloader): save video/MP3/images from TikTok, Instagram, VK, OK, X + 11 more, no watermark
- [PDF to Word](https://qrixtools.com/pdf-tools/pdf-to-word): editable DOCX with layout kept 1:1
- [PDF Tools](https://qrixtools.com/pdf-tools): merge, split, compress, OCR, sign + 16 more
- [Background Remover](https://qrixtools.com/ai-tools/background-remover): AI cutout to transparent PNG, full resolution
- [AI Tools](https://qrixtools.com/ai-tools): upscaler, denoiser, avatar generator, OCR + 24 more
- [Image to 3D](https://qrixtools.com/3d-tools/image-to-3d): photo to textured 3D model (GLB/OBJ/STL)
- [Image Tools](https://qrixtools.com/image-tools): compress, resize, convert + 60 more
- [Video Tools](https://qrixtools.com/video-tools): trim, compress, GIF, extract audio — in-browser
